rows.text_1_facilitator::eng: Today’s skill is about how you can keep control and manage your anger when dealing with stressful moments. 💚
rows.text_2::eng:
🌷Anger is a normal part of everyday life, no matter where you live. So is misbehaving - especially if you are a child!

💙 Feeling angry with your child has nothing to do with how much you love them or how good a job you are doing at parenting them.

💡 Learning how to manage your anger can help keep everyone safe.

rows.text_1_facilitator::eng: Here’s a question to help you think about managing these feelings with your child.
rows.quiz_1_question::eng: True or False: When I am angry at my child, I should show that I am angry so that they stop misbehaving.
rows.quiz_1_feedback_1::eng:
❌ That’s incorrect. 

💛 Misbehaviour can be difficult, but try to manage your own stress and control your own anger before doing anything. 

🌱 Taking deep breaths will help. Being angry may cause you to say or do things you will later regret.

➡️ You can also redirect or ignore negative behaviour without ignoring your child when they are making you angry.
rows.quiz_1_feedback_2::eng:

rows.text_1_facilitator::eng: @data.characters.f1_mother.name has her hands full and having two of her children fighting over a phone isn’t helping. Let’s see how she’s managing her anger:

rows.character_1_text::eng: @data.characters.f1_son_5.name and @data.characters.f1_daughter_6.name, come and help me prepare dinner. We are making your favourite dish!
Thank you for helping me get these veggies clean for our dinner tonight!

rows.text_1_facilitator::eng:
Controlling your actions in anger is not easy. 😔

3️⃣ Practising these three steps will help you interact with your child in a more useful way.
rows.section_1_text::eng:
🌷 Breathe in and out slowly 5 times before speaking or acting. 
☀️ Step away for 10 minutes to regain control of your emotions. A safe outdoor space is a good option!
rows.section_2_text::eng:
🧸 Sometimes anger might come from something else - like being tired, hungry or stressed. 
🌿 Make sure you get enough rest, eat when you are hungry, and find ways to manage stress before it builds up.
💚 Ask someone for support when you are feeling alone.
rows.section_3_text::eng:
☕ Stay connected - talk to friends, family, or other support networks everyday. 💙
❗ Lock away or remove anything dangerous that can be used to hurt others from your home.
🚗 It’s OK to have your children stay somewhere safe while you recover.

rows.quiz_1_question::eng: Here’s a home activity! ⭐ If you start feeling angry today, breathe in and out slowly 5 times before you do anything and notice how you feel. Can you do this today? ⏰
rows.quiz_1_feedback_1::eng: Great! 💙 Be proud of yourself when you manage to control your anger!
rows.quiz_1_feedback_2::eng: Great! 💙 Be proud of yourself when you manage to control your anger!
rows.quiz_1_feedback_3::eng: That's OK! If you don't have time today, practise controlling any anger you feel tomorrow. You can practise this skill any time you start feeling angry. You are a super parent! 😃
